item.tib: stag la phur bu rtse med kyi rgyud las tshe sgrub g.yung drung thig le 'od gur
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni dbal bon gyis/ phung bon la brgyud/ de nas dar nub res shig byung kyang (yang) / ma 'ongs kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis/ me rta zla 6 tshes 1 la/ gyim shod ri'i nub phyogs mdun zhol du bgyis pa'i (pas) g.yung drung bon bstan rgyal nas 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs 'grub 'gyur cig
